## R Markdown
### Sub-header
#### Another, smaller sub-header
>This is a block quote

1. Step1
2. Step2
3. Step3   #ordered list

* First bullet
* Second bullet
First Header    | Second Header
----------------|----------------
Content       |   Content Cell

![myimage]((img/rmarkdownflow.png)](https://env872.github.io/assets/images/rmarkdownflow.png)

>This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see 

[mylink] (http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com).

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
summary(cars)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.

```{r demo chunk, echo=FALSE}
#Echo = false only shows output
#include = false does not anything (output nor code)
#eval and include = false doesn't run code and doesn't show anything
#click on gear and go to chunk options to see what they do 
x = 1
y = 13
print (x+y)


```
